notes: Keep the attack distinct from subsequent Hazara sit-ins and solidarity events.

title: Planned KP government-employees Islamabad protest cancelled after negotiations
reason: The planned Islamabad protest was cancelled before occurrence; article documents union-government negotiation in Peshawar, not a public protest gathering.
notes: The meeting may be relevant as accommodation to a threatened action but does not qualify as a mass protest event.

title: APCA planned Murree Road demonstration / Punjab clerks strike
reason: Opened report is pre-event: it announces an office strike and says representatives planned a Murree Road protest, but no post-event evidence of a qualifying public assembly has been found yet.
notes: Provisional unverified lead, not a claim that the planned protest did not occur; follow up for actual attendance. Pen-down/office strike alone does not demonstrate a public gathering.

title: AJK grassroots food-inflation protest activity mentioned in January digest
reason: The opened later digest describes inflation protests over preceding months but provides no dated January public assembly, site-level attendance, or exact action.
notes: Lead retained for original-source follow-up; not a claim that no January gathering occurred.

title: Muttahida Awami Movement anti-inflation rally, Rawalpindi (user-posted clip lead)
reason: A Reddit clip caption is the only captured lead; no primary or independent contemporaneous attendance report has been verified. It remains unconfirmed, not an assertion that no rally occurred.
notes: Search exact organizer/date in Urdu and English; do not count the repost as evidence of a qualifying crowd.

title: WAPDA rally outside LESCO headquarters reported by HRCP
reason: The actual HRCP report concerns a Jan26 2023 rally, outside the January 2021 unit.
notes: The 2024 HRCP report is titled State of Human Rights in 2023 and its body plus footnote 85 identify the cited rally as Jan26 2023. It is not evidence for a Jan2021 gathering; the The News Jan26 2021 source is a separate report and body dates its rallies to Monday Jan25.
